_about: Hand-curated reference guidance linking each pollution signature to commonly used Indian clean-air measures and when to start them. It summarises public policy instruments (NCAP, CAQM/GRAP, MoEFCC/CPCB rules) for planning conversations. It is NOT official advice; check current rules with the cited agencies before acting.
_lead_months: How many months BEFORE the first high-risk month a measure should start. 0 = during the risk months. 'year_round' measures have no seasonal timing.

postmonsoon_smoke.label: Post-monsoon smoke (crop-residue season)
postmonsoon_smoke.plain: In October and November, smoke from burning paddy straw (in your region or upwind) pushes fine-particle levels up sharply.

measures.action: Line up paddy-straw management before harvest: crop-residue machinery through custom-hiring centres, and straw supply contracts with biomass power, brick kiln, and compressed-biogas plants.

reference.title: Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) directions on paddy-straw management

measures.action: Run farmer outreach and bio-decomposer spraying campaigns in villages with past fire hotspots.
Track satellite fire detections daily and send field teams to new fire clusters.
measures.owner: District nodal officers, State Pollution Control Board

measures.action: Issue health advisories for schools and vulnerable groups on smoke-forecast days.

winter_stagnation.label: Winter smog (stagnant air)
winter_stagnation.plain: In winter, cold, still air and a shallow mixing layer trap local emissions near the ground, so everyday sources build up to unhealthy levels.

measures.action: Agree graded action stages before winter: AQI triggers, which activities stop at each stage, and named enforcement teams.
measures.owner: City clean-air cell, State Pollution Control Board

measures.action: Step up road-dust control: mechanised sweeping, water sprinkling, paving unpaved shoulders, and prompt pothole repair.
Stop open burning of waste and biomass for heating: night patrols, plus heaters or clean fuel for night shelters and security staff.
Use 3–5 day AQI forecasts to pre-announce restrictions (construction, diesel generators, polluting fuels) before stagnant spells.
Public health alerts and school timing changes on Very Poor or Severe days.

premonsoon_dust.label: Pre-monsoon dust
premonsoon_dust.plain: From March to May, hot, windy and dry weather lifts mineral dust from open land, roads and deserts, mostly coarse PM10.

measures.action: Enforce construction and demolition dust rules: covered material, wind barriers, water spraying, and covered transport.
measures.owner: Urban local body, State Pollution Control Board

reference.title: MoEFCC dust-mitigation rules and C&D Waste Management Rules

measures.action: Plant green belts and windbreaks, and stabilise open land and road shoulders. Plant in the previous monsoon so cover is established by March.
Pass on IMD dust-storm warnings with outdoor-work and school advisories.

industrial_combustion.label: Industrial / coal combustion (high SO₂)
industrial_combustion.plain: SO₂ is high relative to traffic NO₂ all year, which points to coal-fired power, mining or heavy industry nearby.

measures.action: Check that thermal power plants are on track with SO₂ emission norms and flue-gas desulphurisation (FGD).
Audit online continuous emission monitoring for red-category industries and move clusters to cleaner fuels (e.g. piped natural gas).
Cover coal transport and storage, and suppress dust on haul roads near mines and plants.

urban_traffic.label: Urban traffic & combustion (high NO₂)
urban_traffic.plain: High NO₂ points to dense vehicle traffic and urban fuel burning; it usually gets worse in winter.

measures.action: Enforce Pollution Under Control (PUC) checks and act against visibly polluting vehicles; manage heavy diesel freight entry at peak hours.
Add buses and electrify the fleet; improve last-mile, walking and cycling links.
Clear congestion hotspots and manage parking.

cleaner_baseline.label: Lower-pollution baseline
cleaner_baseline.plain: Pollution is lower than in most NCAP cities, with no strong seasonal source. The job is to keep it that way.

measures.action: Protect the gains: keep monitoring, screen new industrial siting, and prevent open waste burning as the city grows.
measures.owner: Urban local body, State Pollution Control Board

mixed.label: Mixed sources
mixed.plain: No single season or source dominates; several moderate sources add up.

measures.action: Run a city source-apportionment study to find the biggest local contributors before committing large budgets.
measures.owner: State Pollution Control Board, research institutions
